form.label: UniFi App - Setup
form.description: Discover which indexes hold your UniFi TA data and your UniFi syslog, then write the index macros. No restart needed.

div.h3: 1. Find the index that holds the UniFi TA data
div.p: This searches the last 24h for the TA's device events and shows which index they land in.

table.title: Candidate indexes for UniFi TA data (sourcetype=unifi:*)

search.query: | metasearch index=* (sourcetype=unifi:device OR sourcetype=unifi:device:stats OR sourcetype=unifi:client) | stats count by index | sort - count
| metasearch index=* (sourcetype=ubnt OR sourcetype=ubnt:wireless OR sourcetype=ubnt:dns) | stats count by index, source | sort - count

div.p: Enter the full search expression for each (e.g. index=unifi and index=netops source=sc4s). The current values are pre-filled.
div.label: unifi_index
unifi_syslog_index
div.p: After saving, run the two lookup-generating searches (Settings → Searches, reports, and alerts) once, or wait for the 15-minute schedule.
